sender.en: A girl or boy “your age” on social media or a game

name.en: Sextortion: “send money or I’ll share your photos”

how.en: Offenders create realistic profiles, often posing as a girl of a similar age, and chat with young people on social media, games and messaging apps. They push the young person to send intimate photos or videos, then threaten to send them to friends and family unless they pay money or gift cards, or send more images. Paying usually leads to more demands. Victims are not to blame and help is available.

text.en: Someone your age starts chatting with you on social media or in a game.
They flirt and push you to send intimate photos or video.
They threaten to send the images to your friends and family.
They demand money, gift cards or more images, and tell you not to tell anyone.
I have your pics and your followers list. Send $300 in gift cards in the next hour or I send everything to your family and your school. Don’t tell anyone.

en: A new online friend who quickly asks for intimate photos.
Threats to share images unless you pay or send more.
Demands for money or gift cards.
Stop all contact. Don’t pay or send more images: it usually leads to more demands.
Don’t delete your account or messages; take screenshots of the profile and messages.
Tell a trusted adult. You are not in trouble and not to blame.
Report it to Cybertip.ca or your local police. Help is available to get images removed.
